title: Manyhands JSON v1 remote mutation data
description: The data of a remote add or remote select envelope. It may accompany any outcome: a success, a no-op, a partial result, and a rejection that is about the remote. A remote that is added is shown by no effect, so this and the outcome say what the request did.

name.description: The remote the request names. Null for a remote select that clears the selection.

location.description: The location a remote add gave the remote, redacted. It is not a location to connect to. Null for remote select, which names a remote and gives no location.
